confirmedFindings.title: Reflected Untrusted Record-Route Enables Open Relay
confirmedFindings.body: The outbound route-set generator copies unvalidated Record-Route headers from inbound SIP requests into outbound routing sets, allowing external untrusted entities to steer SIP signaling through arbitrary third-party relays.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Filter Record-Route entries against a whitelist of trusted internal proxy domain patterns.
